presentation.label: Pitch readout on UP + TEMPO
presentation.summary: Hold UP and press TEMPO to read the selected audio track’s note, octave, cents and frequency in a tuner window.
presentation.overview: Tuner reads the selected audio track after its effects and before its fader. Its note, octave, cents, frequency and needle are designed to help tune a steady pitched sound. It uses no effect slot. This draft offers card builds only; the captured older candidate demonstrates window navigation, not live pitch or hardware qualification.
highlights: UP then TEMPO opens and closes the tuner window.
Follows the selected audio track; no effect slot or parameter assignment.
Fixed A4 = 440 Hz, with a cents needle and frequency readout.
Source behavior retains the last reading when the signal is too quiet or uncertain.
usage: Include Tuner in a reviewed build and select an audio track with a steady pitched sound. No effect slot is required.
Hold UP first, then press TEMPO. The tuner window shows the selected track, note, octave, cents and frequency.
Adjust the sound at its source while watching the needle. Near the centre the measured pitch approaches the displayed note, with A4 fixed at 440 Hz.
Press TEMPO, YES or NO to close the window. Hold UP and press TEMPO again to toggle it back on.

limitations: Current v2.20 source is unbuilt and untested. The preserved seven UI screenshots and prior native build belong to the older v2.19/card-sdk image and do not qualify this revision.
The signal is taken after track effects and before the track fader. It is a monophonic pitch estimate; complex, noisy or inharmonic sounds can wander or select an octave.
Below the signal or confidence threshold, the last valid reading is held. A held reading does not indicate the current pitch.
A4 is fixed at 440 Hz. No calibration control, parameter locks, LFO destination or saved project setting is added.
Hold UP before TEMPO. Pressing TEMPO first follows the ordinary tempo-window path.
Card builds only: the base has no removal refusal for ordinary modules.
The standalone 2.19 reference exited before capture, so paired visual equivalence is unavailable. No live pitch, needle response or audio result is claimed.
The retained older emulator fault is in its DSP write callback; the triggering image property remains unresolved.

resources.recorded: 26 October 2026; current hardware timing and resource qualification remain unmeasured

storage.label: ColdFire code and working memory
storage.conditions: One global tuner instance with a sample ring and detector workspace in DRAM. Exact current code, data, stack, loader and alignment totals require the named build.

processing.label: ColdFire pitch analysis
processing.conditions: While open, the frame hook copies selected-track samples and the UI task analyses them approximately seven times a second. No detector runs in the interrupt. Current chip timing and maximum-load behavior remain unmeasured.

impact.conditions: One open tuner on the selected audio track. Estimates describe source structure, not measured hardware headroom.

cpu.rationale: A bounded sample-copy hook runs each audio block while open; the UI task periodically performs autocorrelation and pitch refinement. Current worst-case cycles and scheduling impact are unmeasured.

dsp.rationale: No DSP program, effect slot or DSP state is added. The tuner reads the existing audio read-back arena.

memory.rationale: One global sample ring and detector workspace; no per-track allocation or new sample storage. Current linked allocation, loader overhead and stack maximum are unmeasured.

tests.summary: Current v2.20 source update is unbuilt and untested. Historical v2.19 card-sdk build and UI observations remain separately attributed; hardware, timing and resource qualification remain pending.

license.declaration: The exact upstream source and its MIT terms are retained. The licence covers authored source and documentation; it grants no rights to Elektron firmware and asserts no hardware qualification.
